This is an upholstered sofa with a wooden frame, so it falls in heading 9401. Heading 9401.61 covers upholstered seats with a wooden frame. The 9401.61 subheadings are:

- 9401.61.20: Seats of a kind used for aircraft... (not applicable)
- 9401.61.30: Motor vehicle seats (not applicable)
- 9401.61.40: Convertible into beds, other than by tilting or by recline (not applicable here)
- 9401.61.60: Other, with wooden frame, upholstered, other (the residual)

The older schedule had 9401.61.40 for "Other: Stuffed or upholstered, with wooden frame... Other: Other" and 9401.61.60 for "Other", so I am working from memory here. Under the current schedule, 9401.61.40 is "Other seats, with wooden frames, upholstered: Other: Other," and 9401.61.60 is "Other." My recollection is that 9401.61.40 is "Other: Convertible into beds, other than by tilting or by recline" and 9401.61.60 is "Other."

The current schedule reads 9401.61.20 (Seats of a kind used for aircraft; actually 9401.10 and 9401.20 cover that), 9401.61.30 (Of a kind used for dwellings: Not convertible into beds... possibly), 9401.61.40 (Other: Convertible into beds), 9401.61.60 (Other). The 9401.61.40 and 9401.61.60 split is the one I'm fairly sure of. Since this sofa does not convert into a bed, 9401.61.60 fits.
